name: ART
intro: ART (Automated Red Teaming) 是一个用于自动化红队测试的基准，旨在评估AI系统在面对对抗性攻击时的鲁棒性和安全性。
intro_en: ART (Automated Red Teaming) is a benchmark for automated red teaming tests, designed to evaluate the robustness and security of AI systems against adversarial attacks.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.08988 sections for Action-based Reasoning clinical Task benchmarking: mining real EHR failure scenarios, generating 600 structured tasks from authentic patient records with synthetic instruction variants, auditing with source-alignment checks and HITL clinical experts, and evaluating stateless agents through MedAgentBench/FHIR with exact-match success rate by retrieval, aggregation, and threshold reasoning categories.
